headline: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer | AI | Android/iOS
page_title: Rajendra P N - Azure Kubernetes Platform Engineer
summary_html: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer and senior Kubernetes platform engineer with 10+ years of cloud engineering and production delivery experience. Engineers end-to-end AKS architecture, security, administration, observability, scaling, and upgrades using Terraform, Azure DevOps, Helm, and Python. Deploys GPU workloads, Milvus/Qdrant vector databases, and FastAPI microservices. Partners with engineering teams on platform standards, technical evaluations, incident troubleshooting, and operational readiness.

skill_sections.title: AKS Architecture & GKE Knowledge
skill_sections.content: AKS: cluster design, node pools, availability zones, private networking, Azure CNI, ingress, DNS, RBAC, workload identity, quotas; GKE knowledge: architecture, node pools, release channels, maintenance and upgrades

skill_sections.title: Kubernetes Security & Operations
skill_sections.content: Image vulnerability scanning, hardened containers, least privilege, NetworkPolicies, Key Vault integration, TLS certificates, secret rotation, incident troubleshooting

skill_sections.title: AI & Vector Database Platforms
skill_sections.content: GPU node pools, NVIDIA device plugin, GPU resource requests, taints/tolerations, node affinity, Milvus, Qdrant, Helm, StatefulSets, persistent storage, backup/restore

skill_sections.title: Lifecycle, Scaling & Optimization
skill_sections.content: AKS upgrades, API compatibility, maintenance windows, surge capacity, cordon/drain, PodDisruptionBudgets, node-image updates, HPA, cluster autoscaler, requests/limits

skill_sections.title: Microservices & Delivery
skill_sections.content: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, Azure Container Registry, Helm, Argo CD, health probes, controlled rollouts

skill_sections.title: Observability & Infrastructure Automation
skill_sections.content: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, alerts, dashboards, Terraform, Bicep, Azure CLI, Bash, PowerShell, Linux

achievements.text: Connects cluster architecture, infrastructure automation, application onboarding, security, observability, and day-to-day administration into maintainable platform services.
Deploys isolated GPU capacity and persistent vector database services to support AI applications and FastAPI-based microservices.
Plans Kubernetes upgrades around API compatibility, disruption budgets, capacity, validation, and production recovery readiness.

experience.title: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer
impact: Planned AKS control-plane and node-pool upgrades with API-deprecation checks, add-on compatibility testing, maintenance windows, surge capacity, PodDisruptionBudgets, node-image updates, and staged validation.
Evaluated GPU, vector-search, and deployment capabilities through proofs of concept, documenting capacity, security, supportability, and cost tradeoffs for stakeholders.
Owned end-to-end AKS platform architecture and administration, aligning cluster capabilities, application onboarding, engineering standards, and operational runbooks with platform roadmap priorities.
Deployed Milvus and Qdrant through Helm; administered persistent storage, resource sizing, access controls, backup procedures, and restore validation for vector-search services.

Provided senior production escalation support for scheduling, image-pull, crash-loop, storage, networking, and resource-pressure incidents; documented root causes, recovery steps, and corrective actions.
Delivered FastAPI and REST microservices through Azure DevOps, Azure Container Registry, and Helm, configuring health probes, environment settings, ingress routing, and controlled rollouts.
Deployed GPU node pools for AI applications, validating NVIDIA device-plugin readiness, GPU resource requests, node affinity, and taints/tolerations for workload isolation.

Secured workloads with image vulnerability scanning, hardened containers, network policies, Key Vault secrets, and TLS lifecycle management; coordinated remediation and certificate/connectivity troubleshooting.
Tuned requests/limits, HPA, cluster autoscaler settings, and node-pool sizing to balance stability, performance, and cost; reviewed capacity requirements with application teams.
Built Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana dashboards and alerts for node health, pod restarts, deployment status, application latency, and capacity.
Provisioned AKS, system/application node pools, networking, registry, and identity integrations with Terraform and Bicep; administered namespaces, RBAC, workload identity, and quotas.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Engineered Kubernetes workload deployment patterns with Helm and version-controlled manifests, aligning application configuration with environment and operational standards.
Integrated container image validation and security checks into delivery pipelines and partnered with developers on remediation and deployment readiness.
Partnered with development and QA teams to standardize Kubernetes deployment practices, troubleshoot runtime issues, and improve engineering handoffs.
Administered namespaces, services, ConfigMaps, secrets, and resource settings and diagnosed pod scheduling, container startup, and service-connectivity failures.
Maintained Linux and Windows build agents and reusable delivery workflows for repeatable image builds, automated tests, artifact publication, and release approvals.
Used workload health checks and staged rollouts to verify application changes before promotion and documented recovery steps for failed releases.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Supported GPU-enabled AKS application deployments, validating workload placement, resource allocation, and operational telemetry with application teams.
Planned AKS upgrade readiness by reviewing version compatibility, deployment manifests, health probes, resource capacity, and maintenance requirements.
Provisioned Azure and AKS infrastructure with Terraform and ARM templates and deployed containerized services using Helm and Argo CD.
Managed Kubernetes workloads, node-pool capacity, deployment configuration, and secure application connectivity across engineering environments.
Built Python and PowerShell automation for environment validation, deployment checks, and recurring cluster administration tasks.
Correlated Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and pipeline telemetry to isolate pod, networking, infrastructure, and deployment failures.
Maintained release runbooks, versioned artifacts, and post-deployment checks to support consistent operational handoffs.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Built reusable Terraform modules for Azure networking and AKS, standardizing infrastructure provisioning and application deployment patterns.
Used Prometheus and Grafana telemetry to troubleshoot application and platform issues and support reliable production releases.
Automated Linux and deployment operations with Ansible and Python and documented platform support and recovery procedures.
Packaged and deployed microservices through Kubernetes and Helm, aligning application configuration, environment secrets, health checks, and release dependencies.
Developed Python FastAPI integrations for Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog to automate onboarding, release coordination, and operational workflows.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and Xray and integrated SonarQube checks and secure artifact promotion into delivery workflows.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Built Jenkins and Maven pipelines for REST microservices across testing, security validation, UAT, and production environments.
Packaged Kubernetes services with Helm and managed environment configuration for repeatable deployment and operational support.
Integrated Key Vault and secure database connectivity and supported certificate, credential, and application-connectivity troubleshooting.
Automated Azure virtual machines, networking, and Linux configuration with ARM templates, Ansible, and PowerShell.
Investigated application and deployment failures with ELK, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics and coordinated verified service recovery with engineering teams.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Automated Azure infrastructure and application provisioning with Terraform, ARM templates, and Ansible.
Troubleshot Linux, build, configuration, and release failures with development and operations teams and documented recovery steps.
Created repeatable pipelines for API, database, and UI components and maintained Git branching practices and build-agent configuration.
Developed Python and PowerShell scripts for deployment preparation, administration, and environment diagnostics.
